results.content: The United Nations has warned that poorly planned housing developments could worsen transportation costs, infrastructure pressure and environmental risks for Nigerians. results.title: Persistent Losses Drag Stock Market Below N160trn Mark
results.content: The Nigerian stock market began the week sharply lower, as the overall capitalisation fell below the N160 trillion mark. All-Share Index (ASI) dropped by 2,261.39 points, representing a loss of 0.91 per cent to close at 245,278.34 points.
